$comment: amphora bundled-content manifest. Generated from docs/04-ASSET-MANIFEST.md. Each entry maps a ComponentId (lowercase ContentComponent name) to an APK-bundled asset, its pinned SHA-256 (null = pending lock, verification skipped), a version string, and a provisioning kind. ARCHIVE = tar extracted to filesDir/amphora-content/<component>/<version>/; WCP = Winlator Component Package installed via ContentsManager.extraContentFile (local extract, bypasses the D4 download stub); ROOTFS = owned by RootfsInstaller (not resolved by BundledContentSource).
